coverage.assignmentCoverage: All candidate types mapped to at least one specialist role; each English example is assigned to grammar/usage review and each Vietnamese example translation to bilingual review.

assignments.title: Lead Lexicographic Reviewer
assignments.scope: Entry/sense boundaries, homograph numbering, sense definitions, polysemy versus constructions, and analyse/analysis/analytical family relations.
criticalQuestions: Should bank financial and river meanings be separate entries, separate senses, or a presentation-level distinction?
Is bank homograph numbering warranted or provisional?
Do run machine intransitive and run a machine/program transitive uses belong to one sense or distinct senses?
Are analyse, analysis, and analytical family links synchronically justified without implying unsupported derivation?
Are definitions broad enough for evidenced meanings while preserving distinctions?
assignments.authority: Owner-appointed with lexicographic scope verified independently

assignments.title: Grammar & English Usage Reviewer
assignments.scope: All 9 constructions, sense-level grammar, countability, transitivity, valency, preposition optionality, phrasal-verb separability, collocation and English example idiomaticity.
criticalQuestions: Is analysis countability represented correctly as both count and noncount where context permits?
Does borrow distinguish direct object from optional from-source complement without a false double-object frame?
Do run machine sense metadata and intransitive/transitive construction frames agree?
Are depend on and look up patterns, pronoun placement and separability accurate?
Are advice frames countability and examples idiomatic?
requiredOutputs: Idiom/collocation assessment for every English example
assignments.authority: Owner-appointed English grammar/usage reviewer with scope verified independently

assignments.title: English–Vietnamese Bilingual Reviewer
assignments.scope: All 16 gloss-only translation equivalences and all 15 Vietnamese example translations; contextual restrictions, semantic roles and false-equivalence risks.
criticalQuestions: For run-machine, when is hoạt động suitable and when is vận hành preferable?
Do borrow/lend map roles correctly across mượn/cho mượn/vay/cho vay?
Does analysis distinguish sự phân tích from bản phân tích by context?
Are big/large substitutions restricted to evidenced contexts?
Does advice mean lời khuyên or lời tư vấn in each example/context?
requiredOutputs: Claim-specific contextual judgment for every gloss and translation
No conversion from gloss-only to sense-aligned without separate authorization/evidence
assignments.authority: Owner-appointed bilingual English–Vietnamese reviewer with scope verified independently

assignments.title: Evidence, Rights & Data Integrity Reviewer
assignments.scope: All source references and example reuse obligations, independence, evidence specificity, intended reuse, candidate identity, reviewer authority and publication prerequisites.
criticalQuestions: Does each source exist in the cited edition and support this exact claim at a pinpoint location?
Are references independent or derivative?
Is each source publicly accessible, suitable for reference, independently verified, and licensed for redistribution—each separately?
Are editorial examples original and documented, with intended reuse scope?
Are candidate IDs and snapshot digest intact, and is reviewer authority properly appointed?
requiredOutputs: Rights basis and permitted reuse scope, or explicit unresolved blocker
Identity and authority checks without relying on commit authorship
assignments.authority: Owner-appointed evidence/rights/data reviewer with relevant rights authority verified independently
